region_scene_page.compact: Trip-hop and downtempo emerged around Bristol and adjacent sample culture by slowing the dance impulse into mood, shadow, and groove.
region_scene_page.standard: Trip-hop and downtempo emerged around Bristol and adjacent sample culture by slowing the dance impulse into mood, shadow, and groove. Portishead's Sour Times, Massive Attack, Sneaker Pimps' 6 Underground, and Air's Sexy Boy give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Trip-hop and downtempo emerged around Bristol and adjacent sample culture by slowing the dance impulse into mood, shadow, and groove. The distinct feature is restraint: heavy feeling without festival impact, groove without rush. Portishead's Sour Times, Massive Attack, Sneaker Pimps' 6 Underground, and Air's Sexy Boy give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
